info.title: agenteam System Model configuration HTTP
info.description: System configuration is bound in the default Central root; A System openai-compatible provider shares endpoint/credential across chat and embedding models; discovery and model management tests select the existing two concrete adapters; Project runtime binding remains independent. Current Credential metadata and bounded Model deletion-impact reads are available. Canonical Host/Origin/Fetch-Metadata checked before route/auth/body; ambiguous paths rejected without redirects, no X-Forwarded trust or CORS. Current real Account Session/admin required. System scope and Purpose=Model are server-owned. Secret writes and later Provider binding are independent commands. Required embedding/summary cannot be cleared. All integers above int32 use canonical decimal strings; UUIDs canonical v7. All success is 200; unknown path404, unsupported method405 with exact Allow. Authentication errors do not clear browser Session cookies.

get.description: Current System administrator only; recheck the current Session/admin in the same read transaction. No query string (including empty ?), request body, cursor, limit or replacement input. No CSRF token or Idempotency-Key is required for GET/HEAD. The total request budget, including authentication and lock wait, is at most 3 seconds and inherits earlier caller cancellation. Publish only after the read transaction is actually Committed and the caller is still active. No automatic retry, ETag, 304 or cache. Return only the current System Purpose=Model Credential metadata. Absent, deleted, wrong scope or another purpose is 404. No material, digest, payload, lease, historical receipt or deleted flag.

200.description: Confirmed current read observation.

default.description: Safe RFC 9457 Problem. 400 InvalidArgument; 401 Unauthenticated/SessionRevoked; 403 Forbidden/OriginDenied; 404 NotFound; 405 MethodNotAllowed; 409 ResourceBusy only when the reference count exceeds 10000; 503 DependencyUnbound/DependencyUnavailable/CommitUnknown; original database/lock/cancellation faults may project as 500 InternalError. Failures return no candidate metadata or count. CommitUnknown describes this read transaction, preserves the existing public Problem projection, and supplies no command identity. A new GET is a new observation: do not invent an idempotency key or use command lookup, and do not infer an old writer terminal state.

post.description: Explicit bounded management operation using the saved model/provider configuration and optional bounded Chat input. Current Session/admin/CSRF and both expected versions are required. Global 4 concurrent/no queue; strict TLS/current outbound policy and proxy, no redirects or environment proxy. Same key/body returns the stored result without another upstream request; pending returns COMMIT_UNKNOWN/replay. Stopped-process recovery records unknown/interrupted. Finite answer_text is returned for successful Chat only; failures expose safe reason without upstream response text.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Original command key, including POST lookup; never a new query command.

200.description: Confirmed domain result. No extra canonical GET after write.

default.description: Current permission/CSRF/CAS failures use the shared Problem schema. Pending/ambiguous operation is503 COMMIT_UNKNOWN/unknown/replay; repeat the original POST identity, never automatically start another operation.

requestBody.description: Strict JSON object, maximum 16 MiB on this endpoint only. Unknown/duplicate keys, trailing JSON, non-UTF-8, invalid media/base64 and malformed null/scalars rejected. Optional input is Chat-only; original key/body recovers its receipt without resending.

Session.description: HTTPS host-only HttpOnly SameSite=Lax Secure Path=/.

LocalSession.name: agenteam_local_session
LocalSession.description: Isolated literal loopback HTTP mode, host-only HttpOnly SameSite=Lax Path=/.

protocol.description: The compatible gateway family shares one endpoint and credential across chat, embedding, reranker and image_generation. Chat, embedding and image generation use OpenAI formats; reranker uses the Jina-compatible /rerank format, not an OpenAI-defined rerank protocol. Concrete legacy enum records remain readable.

reasoning_efforts.description: Model-declared adjustable efforts. Names and values must each be unique. Empty means no configurable effort. A call without an explicit value omits reasoning_effort and retains the provider default.

name.description: Display only: 1–64 Unicode code points, no leading/trailing Unicode whitespace or control characters.

value.description: Exact value sent by the OpenAI-compatible chat profile; never a request-field name.

reasoning_toggle_mode.description: Explicit OpenAI-compatible request dialect, only Chat with reasoning=true and no effort levels. null supports provider default only. enable_thinking uses a top-level boolean; thinking_type uses thinking.type=enabled/disabled. Never inferred from model ID.

Capabilities.description: Reasoning capability does not enable a request setting. Explicit choices must match a declared value; absent choices use the provider default. reasoning=false requires no efforts. max_output must not exceed context_length when both are present.

notes.description: Optional display-only notes, at most 2000 Unicode code points / 8000 UTF-8 bytes; empty is allowed. Never sent as the upstream model ID.

ModelInput.description: Chat requires text input and text output; optional image/file declarations do not enable media requests. Embedding is fixed text input and vector output with no chat-only capabilities or max_output. Reasoning values are protocol values; no selected value leaves the provider default unchanged. Reranker is text input with ranked index/score results (no output modality); image_generation is text input and image output. Both reject chat-only features and capacity fields. Management tests validate bounded protocol responses without downloading image URLs or creating Objects.

CommandLookup.description: Historical command identity observation, not material replay validation or original writer termination proof.

CredentialObservation.description: Committed read observation of a historical receipt under current authorization. False does not prove NotCommitted, termination, or safe key replacement. True does not prove current credential availability or equivalence of new material.

value.description: Nonempty input only; maximum 65536 UTF-8 bytes. Never returned. No credential GET route.
Nonempty input only; maximum 65536 UTF-8 bytes. Never returned. No credential GET route.

reference_groups.description: Positive groups only, each kind/role at most once, sorted lexically; their counts sum exactly to reference_count. Empty is [] not null.

delete_blocker.description: Null only means absence of this known adapter blocker; it does not mean deletion is allowed.

ModelDeletionImpact.description: Zero references implies none and null blocker. Any agent, project_summary, platform embedding or summary requires replacement. Otherwise nonempty platform image/reranker is optional. Any agent/project_summary group sets reference_adapter_unbound.

answer_text.description: Chat success returns plain text (possibly empty), at most 8 KiB UTF-8; non-Chat or unsuccessful tests return null. Never a provider error body or credential.

answer_truncated.description: True only when the successful Chat text exceeded the UTF-8 byte bound. Non-Chat and unsuccessful tests return false.

ManagementTestResult.description: Bounded protocol response, not an Image Artifact/download result. Chat with attachments and Image Generation use an absolute overall/header deadline of 120s and read-idle 30s; all other tests remain 20s. Image response raw 8MiB/decoded base64 6MiB; other responses 1MiB. Cancellation closes and joins actual I/O before independent 5s receipt/lease cleanup. Optional Chat input uses the same media validator/encoder as runtime inputs; PDF is sent natively, text/Markdown/DOCX are explicitly extracted as untrusted attachment text.

protocol.description: New catalog providers use openai-compatible: one endpoint and credential shared by chat and embedding models. Existing endpoint-specific enum records remain readable; this does not add a third wire adapter.

ReasoningChoice.description: default omits reasoning fields. on/off require a declared toggle mapping. effort requires an exact declared value. Non-Chat choices allow default only.

name.description: UTF-8 basename, at most 255 bytes; no controls, slash/backslash, dot/dot-dot or leading/trailing whitespace.

data_base64.description: Strict standard base64, without whitespace. Image/PDF at most 4 MiB decoded; plain/Markdown/DOCX at most 1 MiB. Non-animated GIF only.

ManagementChatAttachment.description: No URL, object key or caller-selected Project reference. The bounded bytes belong only to this explicit management command.

text.description: At most 16 KiB UTF-8, no NUL. Text may be empty when an attachment is present.

ManagementChatInput.description: Chat only. Nonempty text or at least one attachment is required; decoded attachments total at most 8 MiB. Exact order, name, MIME and content digest are bound to the original idempotency key.
